facts.fact: Telma (AXIAN Telecom) stated on 10 February 2023 that the 2Africa cable, which interconnects 33 countries in Africa, Europe and the Middle East, had landed at Mahajanga in Madagascar through a Telma partnership with Vodafone, with the 2Africa East system ready for service in the fourth quarter of 2023.

systems.platform: submarine cable, Alcatel Submarine Networks, 180 Tbit/s
